headline: How to Write Release Notes People Actually Read
snippet: People read release notes that tell them what got better for them. Group the notes by what people do in your app, lead every line with what they get, and leave out anything they never saw. Your AI can draft all of it from your pull requests. The free AI starter kit we build our own products with writes notes this way on every release. Group by what people do Follow the path a person takes through your product, in the order they take it. Write each heading as "When you ...": When you first open the app When you do the main task, with a heading for each main task When you organize or find your work When you change what the app uses, like sources, plans or connections Settings The look everywhere, for changes that touch every screen Skip any heading with nothing new under it. Lead every line with what the user gets Under each heading, write one bold line with the outcome, then a few bullets with the specifics. Write "The model list opens straight away", never "Virtualized the remote model list". Use a real number only when it's true and checked, like "about half a second, down from nearly three". Leave out what nobody saw Cut bugs you made and fixed inside the same release, test data, developer tools and internal checks. If a user would never notice it, it doesn't belong in the notes. Keep it short One line under the title, then the headings. Speak to "you", in short sentences and everyday words. No component names, no code names, no closing summary. Before and after Before After Refactored the auth flow You stay signed in after an update Fixed race condition in sync Notes you write offline show up on your phone Updated dependencies Leave it out unless users notice a change Misc bug fixes List the fixes people would notice, or leave the line out Get the release notes tool we use The starter kit turns your review notes and pull requests into release notes grouped by what people do, in your product's voice, and puts them at the top of the release. Get the starter kit free on GitHub. Questions How should release notes be organized? By what people do in your app, in the order they do it, like when you first open the app, when you do the main task, and settings. Skip any heading with nothing new. What should each release note line say? What the user gets, in plain words. Write "The model list opens straight away", never the technical change behind it. Can AI write release notes from pull requests? Yes. Give it the pull request comments and commit messages, tell it to group changes by user task and lead with outcomes, and have it drop anything users never saw. Originally published at wednesday.is.

Rigid 90s hairstyles have collapsed completely: what replaced the frozen look of the past
snippet: The sleek, lacquered perfection of the modern minimalist braid is yielding to a different standard. The blowout is back, but it has shed the rigid, frozen structure that defined the 1990s iteration. The contemporary version prioritizes movement and an unforced texture, relying on structural architecture rather than heavy fixation to maintain its shape. This shift demands a precise understanding of where the hair begins and how specific technical interventions create the final form. The foundation of this volume is established before any heat is applied. The physical state of the hair shaft determines how it will react to styling. To achieve the desired lift, the weight of the product must be managed strictly. Cleansing is targeted at the scalp and roots, while hydrating treatments are confined to the lengths to prevent the root zone from becoming weighed down. This separation of functions ensures the base remains buoyant. Finishing the wash with cooler water serves a specific mechanical purpose: it helps settle the cuticle, reducing friction and allowing the strands to slide with less resistance, which is a prerequisite for a smooth, light finish. The transition from wet hair to a styled form is governed by thermodynamics. Heat does not hold the shape; it merely makes the hair plastic. The structure is only set when the strand cools. Releasing a strand from a round brush while it is still hot results in immediate collapse under its own gravity. The critical operational step is the application of cold air. By switching the dryer to a cold setting for several seconds while the hair is still on the brush, the internal bonds lock into the new position. This thermal setting is the difference between a temporary lift and a lasting structure.

Elsewhere, Muslim organisations are pressing the government to release long-term prisoners and extend reservation benefits to people who convert to Islam. Meanwhile, threats linked to the Deepam controversy and questions over the government’s handling of religious institutions have added to the unease. This is no ordinary festival dispute. The Madras High Court, first through a single judge in December 2025 and then a Division Bench in January 2026, directed that the traditional Karthigai Deepam be lit at the ancient Deepathoon stone pillar on temple land near Madurai, roughly 50 metres from the Sikandar Badusha Dargah. The judges dismissed the State’s public-order fears as an “imaginary ghost,” affirmed the site’s temple ownership under long-settled records, and ordered the lighting with limited personnel and ASI safeguards. While devotees are detained for demanding compliance with an unstayed High Court order, the TVK government fast-tracks land regularisation for minority religious structures. Burchell says ‘low budget’ Cuthbert-Flynn is ‘chief heckler’ in Parliament
snippet: Opposition spokesperson on culture, information and the creative industries, Nekeisha Burchell, has accused Minister of State in the Ministry of National Security and Peace, Juliet Cuthbert-Flynn, of behaving like a “low budget” labourite. Burchell made the comparison in a video she released on Thursday in which she said she would not be baited into a one-sided apology for statements she directed at Cuthbert-Flynn during a testy sitting of the House of Representatives on November 17. According to Burchell, who is Member of Parliament (MP) for St James Southern, Cuthbert-Flynn, the MP for St Andrew West Rural, is the “chief heckler” in the Parliament. “You come to expect that kind of heckling from the organised groups of labourites bussed into public events like those bussed into Cornwall Regional Hospital last week where I was invited to represent my constituents,” Burchell said. She claimed the JLP supporters stood in her path on the hospital grounds during the official opening of the refurbished Accident and Emergency Department and heckled her. Describing their action as “really low budget behavior”, Burchell said they belonged to the “$5,000 and KFC crowd”. “But I certainly didn’t expect that same low budget behavior inside the Parliament of Jamaica, and instead of rising above it, I responded in kind,” she said. She was speaking about her response to Cuthbert-Flynn questioning her educational acumen when she told the Government MP that, “mi go a gud, gud school enuh. Mi neva run fi a living”. Cuthbert-Flynn is a decorated four-time Olympian and Burchell’s comment was seen as disrespectful to athletes. It drew sharp responses from Government MPs and a call from Sport Minster Olivia Grange for her to apologise. “She was taking jabs at my achievements and I took a jab at hers,” Burchell said in the video but admitted her choice of words could have been better. headline: Cluster Tomatoes: Why High Nitrogen Kills Sweetness
snippet: Turning a garden plot into a high-yield production line starts with a decision on plant architecture. For those seeking dense-fleshed, sweet fruits without excessive acidity, cluster-type tomatoes offer the best balance of compact growth and heavy fruit set. The "Creamy Icicle" variety serves as a specific example of this efficiency, producing oval fruits with a distinct pointed tip, averaging 45-55 grams each. The plant's productivity is defined by its cluster formation, where a single stem typically supports between 5 and 10 fruits. However, the potential of this determinate variety is only realized when the grower synchronizes nutrient inputs with the plant's biological stage. A common failure occurs when gardeners apply excessive nitrogen during the transition from vegetative growth to flowering. Managing the Shift from Growth to Fruiting When nitrogen levels are too high, tomato plants enter a state of "luxury consumption," prioritizing the expansion of stems and foliage over the development of flower clusters. This shift in energy allocation results in a lush, green bush with significantly fewer fruit sets than the variety is capable of producing. The decision to scale back nitrogen and ensure intense lighting is what allows the fruit to accumulate the sugars necessary for the variety's characteristic sweetness.

headline: ICE Confirms Deportation of Guatemalan Illegal Alien Convicted of Aggravated Sexual Battery Following Tennessee Prison Sentence
snippet: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) on Wednesday confirmed the deportation of Felipe Pablo Menchu Yax, a 67-year-old illegal alien from Guatemala who was arrested in Murfressboro, Tennessee, and pleaded guilty to counts of aggravated sexual battery after previously being charged with rape of a child in 2021. The agency reported that authorities still do not know when or where Menchu illegally entered the United States, but said he was arrested in January 2020. When he pleaded guilty to two counts of aggravated sexual battery in August 2026, prosecutors dropped the child rape charge.
